notes.title: SOME BUG FIXES!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26314841/ddd2959f750a6a61caccaddfc645b9d912119d95.gif

Hey Killers! 

Wanted to post a special update today that fixes some bugs and prepares for something special to be coming very soon. Here's a quick rundown of what you can expect:


 BUGFIX: we had this weird issue where sometimes after a bonus kill the game would go to a black screen. This was due to the darkness of the universe coagulating in your computer device causing its internal circuitry to not know what to do next with its life... We input some code to help your computer come to terms with the meaninglessness of the universe and so the black screen no longer happens.
 [strike]NEW FEATURE - Randomize Killer! You can now select an option from the options menu that will randomize the killer you're using every time a new level begins. Do this when you have a bunch of killers and want to add some more surprises to your already surprisey life! [/strike] (Had to pull this for now as it was having some issues and we didnt want the other fixes to wait while we fixed those issues.)
 NEW LOCALIZATION! You can now play the game in Simplified Chinese. We're working on getting the store page text converted as well, but for now feel free to switch to Chinese in the language selector!
 NEW FEATURE: "Message Window" - we've added a special notification window that appears on the shelf screen with any important announcements, game updates, new content, or emergency information. It's pretty integrated right into the game, basically the Tombkeeper pops up to tell you a thing. We have setup a one-time announcement for the PS4/XBox version just to inform players who don't normally check the forums, etc. Once you have seen a message you wont be shown it again, so no worries about eternal spamness or anything horribly horrific like that. We'll also try to use it to give you some special holiday killer kodes from time to time etc. :) 
 LEVEL CHANGE: Movie 8 - Deleted Scene #2 (changed layout of level)
 PLUS: More bug fixes, optimizations and SUPER ULTIMATE SECURITY updates to make your time in Slayaway Camp more enjoyable and stable across the board.


These update should now be available! Keep your eyes peeled for a very special announcement coming on Friday the 13th... that's next week! (http://www.slayawaycamp.com)

ːskullfaceːːslayawaycleaverː

notes.notes:
Hope everyone is having a killer summer, and those camp counsellors are not too much trouble to deal with!

We've posted a new build of Slayaway Camp but its pretty unexciting in the greater scheme, just fixes some weird lil bugs that have been gathering up over time. Hope it makes your Slayaway Camp experience all the more smooth and enjoyable!

 Fixed issues with walkthroughs not working properly, especially with the "Burn Ward" level, reported by Gamesjunkie (thanks!).

notes.title: The 'OMG WOW EVEN MORE BUGFIXES!' Update (v1.6.7)
notes.notes:
Hey Killers! We wanted to make sure to squash a few smaller but annoying bugs that have been plaguing users.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26314841/58fba9dc8ae3eae4386576acd57229103390eccc.jpg

We're going to be launching on Android tomorrow so hooray! Also a huge update to iOS (and Android Launch of course) where we are finally able to bring those much coveted deleted scenes and all their flavour text. Originally we were concerned that Apple would think the flavour text was just too flavourful and would banish us from the app store forever, but apparently this was misguided. 

If you've been holding out for the Android version, we want to thank you from the bottom of our blackened shrivelled hearts for your patience, and hopefully the launch tomorrow will bring you everything you ever dreamed of and more.

ANYWAYS ON TO THIS UPDATE!

Changelog for v1.6.7

 We fixed a bug that was causing the game to forget everything it knows when you hit the rewind button in the final scene of My Gory Valentine. The game spent a solid few weeks talking to a shrink and has rediscovered itself and should no longer have any issues with rewinding on that scene.
 Party's Over actually fixed now. Like, Actually this time.
 Using the options menu you can now switch the exit portal to something different. Like maybe a cute little Kitty Face!! Or.... a demonic magic summoning circle? Or just leave it as a Pentagram. Whatever. 
 Made the "Level Complete" sound effect a little louder. It just wasn't feeling confident so we took it out for lunch and to a few stores downtown so it could pick out some new clothes. It chose a pretty sweet pair of shoes that it paired up with a brand new sun hat that looks just stellar. It's now feeling a lot better about itself and, as such, has been emitting itself at the proper volume.
 In Slayaway Camp 6 NC17 Scene #2, there was a victim who refused to die. This actually caused the puzzle to be unbeatable, which was disappointing to anyone who breathes oxygen and plays Slayaway Camp. We've now fixed it so not only does the victim die when they should, but we also made sure that every waking moment while they are alive, they feel a pain and misery so deep that they longingly ache for death. 
 In the final NC17 level of Bloodbath Beach, you can glitch the game to make a sweet innocent little kitty cat kill-able. This bug was found by one of our favourite mass voxel murderers, JohnOswald, and you can only imagine the depths of depravity in this man's mind to be able to unearth and exploit such a richly evil, heinous bug. Oh.. hold on one second... we're just getting word that the cat in that level is actually a huge a$$h*le, terrorizing the other cats in the neighbourhood on a nightly basis, often sending them to the vet for stitches and/or removal of broken claws stick in various parts of their faces. So, actually, JohnOswald is something of a modern day hero. Our hero.
 Oh and there's a secret somewhere.
 Plus, I guess we also did a bunch more general optimizations and luscious deep tissue massage. So relaxing.


Happy Camp Camp Slay! Buy Slayaway on Android tomorrow! Buy it on iOS Today! BE HAPPY! SUMMER IS HERE! CAMPING SEASON IS ABOUT TO BEGIN!

Hugs,
Slayaway Team ːslayawaycleaverːːskullfaceː

notes.title: SUPERNATURAL FORCES DLC UPDATE! (v.1.6.6)
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26314841/4cd87dba7c25303ba06922cdbded1bb9b5a2a701.gif

Hey you savage bunch of puzzle solving psychopaths! Today is a very special day in that we're releasing our first ever PREMIUM KILLER DLC Pack ːslayawayknifeː. This pack features 6 brand new killers we think are the coolest looking killers we've ever made in the history of the existing universe!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/637001/Slayaway_Camp__Supernatural_Forces_Killer_Pack/

FLAMING SKULLFACE
Nothing says 'I'm pure evil, bro, so step off.' like wearing a leather jacket and having a head that is eternally engulfed in flames. Comes with his super badass special kill: CHOPPERED.

SUPERNATURAL OCCURRENCE
Typically only visible in handy cam night vision, this supernatural spirit is the epitome of shadowy darkness. Comes with their super special kill: DISINHABITED & apply's a hard-mode night vision filter across the full game.

WRAITH
Tired of waiting for people's time to die, this wraith has taken the cause into his own hands. Hovers above the ground with a floaty cloak of pure unimaginable darkness. Comes with his super special kill: FAILED SAVING THROW.

SUMERIAN DEMON
Your run of the mill, average, every-day hell-spawn Sumerian demon with the heaviest of heavy metal animated flaming wings. Comes with its super special kill: TOASTY!

YETI
A mountain snow beast come down from the icy slopes to smash some heads in. Features real patented RasterVox™ fur and brutally frozen falling ice crystals of death. Comes with its super special kill: SNOW JOKE!

PLUS: KEVIN
It's... just... well.. It's Kevin.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/637001/Slayaway_Camp__Supernatural_Forces_Killer_Pack/

MONTHLY MURDERERS SERIES 1!

We've also posted a collected pack of Monthly Murderers (Series 1) for purchase. We were about to fire Nate for spending all his time replying to players about the previously released Killer Kodes, and not getting any actual work done. 

In a desperate plea to keep his job, he proposed we put the past Killer Kodes up as a DLC pack for anyone who missed out. 

Be sure to stay signed up to the Monthly Murderer Club / Mailing list at www.slayawaycamp.com -- also add slayawaycamp@bluewizard.com to your address book to make sure none of the emails go to your spam folder. Because if you email Nate asking for missed codes, we will be asking him to pack up his things into a sad, water stained and ripped brown cardboard box.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/637000/Slayaway_Camp__Monthly_Murderers_Series_1/

ALSO, BUG FIXES! 

We also made some minor bug fixes in this update. Here are the details of those fixes:

 There was a strange issue where DLC Gorepacks were occupying the same shelf space and time of normal gorepacks. Their molecular structures were intermingled so purely they made an all new super gorepack, but it caused sever inter-dimensional instability and so we had to put a stop to it. They should now appear on the shelf properly.
 There was a slight audio click that occurred when you pause the game to go to the shelf, and then back again. This click has been smoothed out into something more of a ___ now. Do enjoy.
 The shadows looked a little like a potato was generating them. We've improved them slightly so they now look more like McDonalds Fries generated them. We'll get them to the point where it looks like Potato Salad with Egg generated them, soon enough.
 Improved movement input response time.


PLUS: We've been working hard to lay the groundwork for a full Simplified Chinese localization. That should be coming within the next month, and will feature some cool new chinese killers, Jianshi & The Killer Kung Fu Panda. Not to mention... Android is on the way soon, too! We will have a special announcement on the Android Release Date any day now :)

Happy Slaying!
The Slayaway Team ːskullfaceːːslayawayknifeː

notes.title: The 'OMG BUGFIXES YEY!' Update (v.1.6.3)
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26314841/a00bd40d9542a68f8cdafdc2dde1387aeacd2873.gif

Hey Killers! We hope your spring is full of stuff that has sprung. We have been working hard on the Android release of the game and getting it ready to launch in closed beta very soon, but also have been making sure we have some cool stuff coming for Steam too, starting with a quick update that fixes some small issues that you have kindly reported to us! For your patience and kindness, Skullface will kill you last.

SWEET NEW DLC'S COMING SOON!!

We've got some great new stuff coming up over the next month or so as well, including the SUPERNATURAL FORCES KILLER PACK: a brand new DLC Pack of premium Killers for just $2 USD.

Super Sweet Supernatural Psycho Killers Include:

 FLAMING SKULLFACE
 SUMERIAN DEMON
 SUPERNATURAL OCCURRENCE 
 WRAITH
 YETI
 PLUS.... kevin


Each killer has a special premium effect, and comes with their very own special Gorepack kill animation. We'll have some more info on it all very soon!

OK OK WHAT ABOUT THE UPDATE TODAY?

Last but not least, here is a changelog for todays patches:


 There was an issue where music would stop, frozen in fear of an unspeakable kill animation taking place and would never return. We've talked to the music gently with our gentle voices so it's not so afraid anymore.
 We've Improved the UI on the Deleted Scenes menus. Should be more pleasing to your retinas now. Or maybe you don't even notice, in which case we've wasted our time, haven't we? We haven't.
 The pause button appeared while a level was loading but you couldn't hit it until the level had actually loaded. This was weird. So we told the pause button to get the hell out of here until the level had actually fully loaded and it seems to have listened.
 If you tried to pause while the Tombkeeper's walkthrough was 'rewinding' itself, you could essentially freeze your voxel killer in its tracks, forever doomed to a rewinding space in the infinitum of space and time. We've resolved this issues so your killer can now kill like a killer should kill.
 We fired the kid working at SKULL VIDEO (the video store on the movie shelf screen). He was a stoner / slacker and kept putting the DLC tapes in weird spots. You know what we said to him? We said "You're Fired" and we did this thing with our fingers like we were plucking a raspberry off an imaginary bush in front of our big orange face. We hired a new kid and she's awesome with the video tapes. Puts them where they're supposed to go all the time. Amazing worker. The best. The best worker.
 There was a gorepack in the Santa's Slay DLC that had the wrong name. Well. Blah blah blah. Now it has the right name.
 The Lawn Mower Gorepack (Party's Over) Was not loading. Im sure this angered Peter Jackson greatly, so we fixed it. It is now fixed. You're welcome, Peter Jackson.


Still working through a couple more bug fixes but didn't want to hold these ones back too much longer so there we go! ːslayawayaxeː

Thanks All, Happy Slaying!
The Slayaway Team ːskullfaceː ːslayawayknifeː

notes.title: THE "LOVE IS LIKE A MACHETE" UPDATE (v1.4)
notes.notes:
Hey Killers!

We've got a brand new update for Slayaway Camp which brings a tonne of great fixes and updates, 

NEW CONTENT & FEATURES

 New Unlockable Gorepack: Freefallin’ - Killer takes Victim on a sweet skydiving bro-trip.
 Checkmarks in the pause menu have been redesigned to be a much much nicer checkmark. Revel in the beauty that is the all-new checkmark!
 Added some super sweet up/down arrows in the movie store, to get you up/down shelves easier. :) 
 Added a checkmark underneath a movie if you have completed it. We’re working on additional notifiers if the movie’s deleted scenes and NC17 levels are complete, but that will have to come in a future update.
 If language is French / keyboard layout is AZERTY, we use ZQSD instead of WASD for movement. Arrow keys still work too, so just use those you silly camper killers.  Laid some hot & sweaty groundwork for the FREE “My Gory Valentine” DLC movie to come out on Tuesday, in celebration of the iOS release!!! 
 We've also added brand new "My Gory Valentine" papercrafts to the Deluxe Edition Papercraft folder!


BUGS FIXED

 Increased the amount of time the “Game Over” credit sequence plays so you have time to dig through that drawer in the kitchen for your favorite lighter, spark it up and hold it over your head, waving it gently back and forth in time to the music.
 Steam was not checking for certain achievements when the game started up. We’ve taken Steam out to the garage, tied it up in a chair, sprinkled doritos on the floor, told it that if it doesn’t start checking for certain achievement when it launches Slayaway Camp that it will be forced to walk barefoot on those doritos. Steam now checks for certain achievements when the game starts up.
 Should have prevented future Linux / OSX Save games from resetting. If you notice your game has been reset in a past update, feel free to get in touch, chances are its still on your system, just in a folder named “Slayaway Camp” instead of a folder called “slayaway camp” apparently letter capitalization is a big deal in Linux, and I respect it for that.
 Made some of the ‘Tutorial hint’ things more clear / easier to read, etc.
 Background music was turning off after cutscenes. This broke GNÜ TRUNTIONS collective heart. It no longer does this. Rock on GNÜ TRUNTION, Rock on.
 Blue Wizard / Staff credits didnt show up when you completed the game anymore. This has been resolved so now you can see exactly who made this game, when you finish every puzzle, of course.
 Sometimes game would get stuck after dying to fire on Movie 2 Deleted Scene “Ritual Gone Wrong” this seems like it would have been part of said ritual that had gone wrong, and therefore a perfect sort of meta-joke, but we fixed it because it wasn’t actually intentional, despite the abundance of ironic humour.
 Texture and Audio optimizations which should help with performance on older systems, but still look super fly on newer ones.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26314841/e7367d30bb000a80a60e0f1bc80f014f10fae638.gif

Get Ready!! On Valentines Day, we will be unveiling the brand new movie "My Gory Valentine" on your video shelves, which boasts a tonne of new puzzle levels, a new killer (Major Miner) and new kill animations. We'll remind you on Valentines Day when it's ready to play!

Happy Slaying,

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26314841/17269971cc4c0b87fc406c20eb82a46f08755606.png
Skullface & the Slayaway Camp Team

 Subtitles on the intro cutscenes, and the ability to turn them off in the pause menu. 
 Your Gorepack collection just got a lot bigger! We've added gorepacks for all the 'Standard' kill animations you see when just starting the game.

 "Need a hint" tutorial no longer appears if the game is paused.

notes.title: The "CURSE OF THE UNDEAD" Patch (v1.08.2)
notes.notes:
I knew i was shooting myself in the foot calling the last update the 'Deadly Blessings' update. :|

We've just pushed a new fix (1.08.2) which resolves an issue with last night's update for players who use a system language other than English. The errors were due to some in-development work we are working on behind the scenes in preparation for wider localisation in the future. One of the changes accidentally made its way into a live build and was wreaking havoc, but has since been patched and everything should be back to normal again. 

We deeply apologise for the inconvenience this caused, and appreciate your patience and reports as we worked to resolve it for you as quickly as possible. The fix should now be available for you to download - if you're still having issues, be sure to fully exit out of Steam to ensure it does the full update.

Some other quick fixes were also made:

 Replaying some NC17 Levels was causing a bug. A bug which has now been eradicated from existence.
 When hovering over buttons in the Deleted Scenes menu the UI wasn't responding to your hoverability. It now does.
 The Bolumetric Dog stops barking at the end of a level - so you'd have to enable him every time you start a new level. We think this is fair. It takes a long time for him to travel between scenes to appear in the background audio of each level, so we felt we needed to give him a rest.
 Typing in the Killer Code box was restarting your level progress.. we've fixed that for now. BUT YOU SHOULDN'T BE TYPING IN THERE YET, YOU DON'T HAVE A CODE... YET! :) Yet! 


Thank you all for your support and kindness as we continue to improve the game...

Happy Slaying!

notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26314841/66e4bb80a0c9cfc3ecc91402129d25e6c0dff5e4.jpg

Hey Killers! ːslayawayknifeː

Just wanted to let you know while EVERYONE ELSE was either flipping out or cheering heartily about the voting results of some sort of Electrical College something or other (sounds pretty deadly, but we’ve got a game to make, people), we were hard at work plugging away on cool new updates for Slayaway Camp. Here’s a list of what you can find in the latest version!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26314841/12cdebc0c87fbeac071da2a14e7ef99d1689b3a3.jpg

UPDATES MADE

 We’ve made it a little easier to grind for extra Skull Coins with a couple very important changes. 1) You now get 10 coins for every kill in Faces of Killed 3. This means if you only kill one victim, you will still get 10 coins. Previously you had to reach tiers, meaning you would only get 50 coins if you reached 5 kills, then only get 50 coins until you reach 10 kills, at which point you’d get 100… etc. Now 1 kill = 10 coins, 2 kills = 20 coins, etc. ALSO if you reach a certain streak of kills you will begin getting double coins (20) for every kill, so it pays to do well! We’ve also optimized some of the Faces of Killed animations so they should be a bit smoother / not affect your accuracy when animating the kill bar. COINS!!! 
 You know how sometimes you get stuck on a puzzle but you don’t want to cheat and use the walkthrough for the puzzle, but you also can’t really figure it out so you leave the game and go make spaghetti or something, then you think of the answer to the puzzle because you can’t stop thinking about it? Well now you can just skip the level (using the FFWD button) instead of making spaghetti, and come back to complete the level later. While this does mean you won’t be making spaghetti, it does mean you can continue solving puzzles that might be a little easier and the resulting brain massage might give you new ideas on how to solve the previous puzzle! We made it so you can’t skip “boss” puzzles (the final puzzle in every movie) since those ones are supposed to be hardcore and if you can’t do it it just means you need to TRY HARDER! Or you can always get the hint ;) 
 You know how you buy a Gorepack from the shop shelf and it sits there all shiny on your shelf looking cool, but not much else until you actually play a puzzle and hope that random Gorepack comes up? Well now Gorepacks can be previewed from your Gorepack shelf. So you can watch them with your friends over and over until you DIE FROM LAUGHING.
 If you pause the game when playing with a gamepad, you should see nice little gamepad prompt showing you what gamepad buttons control what on-screen options. Its helpful and they go away if you un-pause.
 Menu text now appears highlighted on menus when tooltips are disabled. Minor bug. Was annoying.. now fixed.
 Sometimes you’d be playing a beach level and you’d get a weird alien guy as your bonus kill. It was weird. Aliens should only appear if you’re in space. Now Weird victims no longer appear during bonus kills. It’s not as weird anymore. Though I guess the concept of a bonus kill is a little weird in itself…
 We fixed a few bugs that appeared on the super hardcore NC17 levels. Only the super hardcore players will care about this. 
 A handful of minor bug fixes. Only a handful of minor players will care about this.


OH!

If you’re browsing the menu, you might see a cool new menu option called “Killer Code”… We’re super sinister, so we’re not even going to tell you what that’s about until the next update! But…. if you’re interested and are worried you might be making spaghetti when we announce it, be sure to sign up to our mailing list at www.slayawaycamp.com — it’s a new feature we’ll be announcing very very soon and I promise you gals and guys will want to be involved from the very start :)

HELP US HELP YOU

Also don’t forget to leave a review on Steam if you like what we’re doing. It goes a long long way when telling other people that you think the game is awesome! If you don’t think it’s awesome… well, just tell us why and we can make it more awesome for you!!!

Happy Slaying! ːskullfaceː

Hope you all had a safe and Happy Halloween. We've been working hard this week to clean up some bugs but also to add in some cool new stuff as well. When we saw Jim Sterling play Slayaway Camp before Halloween it blew our minds. We  wanted to give him a little thank you gift so voxeled up a little Slayaway Camp Jimsaw Killer based on his original character. Well he loved it and was cool with putting it in the game for you guys, so... WE DID THAT! 

You can now unlock Jimsaw Killer from the Mystery Box!

NEW STUFF!

 NEW MYSTERY KILLER! Jimsaw Killer... 
 NEW BONUS KILL! Flip the Ultra-Gravity Switch 9000.
 NEW BONUS KILL! Roasting faces on the campfire.
 NEW BONUS KILL! Bird of death and destruction.


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26314841/a00bd40d9542a68f8cdafdc2dde1387aeacd2873.gif

BUGS SMASHED

 You know how the controller had some bugs? Well lots of those bugs are gone now. This time, even more of them are gone than we realized. There are still some small things we want to improve but for now REVEL IN THE GLORY THAT IS YOUR GAMEPAD USAGE!
 We had a terrible bug where you could grind away coins in the Faces of Killed 3 bootleg snuff tape of constant death, only to rage quit due to not being able to make it past 26 kills YET AGAIN. Then you'd start the game and find that all those glorious skull coins were not actually saved and so you would weep 1000 tears. Well, coins now save properly after playing Faces of Killed 3.

Well they were SOOOO censored for a few select people that they would wouldn't let you UNWATCH them. This was entirely due to the Canadian Film Censorship Corporation Bureau. http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26314841/a00bd40d9542a68f8cdafdc2dde1387aeacd2873.gif

 You know how the controller had some bugs? Well lots of those bugs are gone now. This time, even more of them are gone than we realized. There are still some small things we want to improve but for now REVEL IN THE GLORY THAT IS YOUR GAMEPAD USAGE!
 We had a terrible bug where you could grind away coins in the Faces of Killed 3 bootleg snuff tape of constant death, only to rage quit due to not being able to make it past 26 kills YET AGAIN.  Movie achievements are no longer "progress bar achievements" but are now straight up golden shiny normal type achievements. Bask in the glory that is their awesomeness.

 You know those dirty dirty censored shower scenes you get as a reward for unlocking the NC17 version of all the movies? Well they were SOOOO censored for a few select people that they would wouldn't let you UNWATCH them. This was entirely due to the Canadian Film Censorship Corporation Bureau. We have put in an appeal for this to be rectified and they have allowed us to submit this new fix which no longer glitches when you are viewing said cutscenes. Do enjoy them. 
 Also we did some bug and graphical fixes for some NC17 levels.
 Plus some minor graphic fixes.
 Plus some more minimal bug fixes.
 Plus a few wee lil itty bitty baby sized text fixes.


HAPPY SLAYING EVERYONE! Don't forget to write a review if you've been enjoying your experience with the game! Have a great weekend. :)

notes.title: THE "INFERNO" UPDATE (v1.03)
notes.notes:
Hey Killers, 

Made some quick fixes for a few things that were causing us to lose some sleep. We wanted to get some of this technical stuff out of the way so we could focus on finishing up a proper FUN update for Halloween (Coming soon!) with a few new kill animations and an awesome new Halloween killer.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26314841/47673ba88d353f93a7cb70e3e5bfc63a0d55e8f0.jpg

NEW(ish) CONTENT

 Ok ok ok it's not really new but by popular demand we have added FLAC formatted audio files to the Official Game Soundtrack in the DLC Pack. You should just have to exit out of Steam and restart it for the DLC to download the extra FLAC files in the soundtrack folder, now.


BUGS FiXED

 Resolved an issue that was causing the above NC17 (Super Challenge Mode) level to be totally unbeatable. Some poor mime was standing in the fire for an eternity, dead eyes staring out at the cold, empty world around him as his silent cells slowly crispified. It was fun to watch him not react to being engulfed in flames forever, but it also meant you couldn't beat the level, which was sad for Jessi and she asked me to upload the patch as soon as humanly possible so no one gets stuck for too long.
 Moar gamepad fixes have been implemented. Things should be getting smoother - still a few things we need to work out but hopefully this is a nice improvement.
 If you paused the game while a victim is escaping the level, it created a tear in the space time continuum, which led to the victim's DNA being scrambled with a piece of toast's DNA (wait does toast have DNA? Maybe a piece of living toast like a toast-man or something does...). Oh also the level would crash. Anyways this doesn't happen anymore, so don't even worry about whether or not toast has DNA, it has been made irrelevant at least in this specific context.
 More general tweaks and fixes to improve your play experience. They are so minor and rare that you probably didn't even realize they were there. That didn't stop us from standing behind the programmers' chairs and smacking them in the head with a bag full of orange juice soaked paper towels until these bugs were fixed, though. Believe you me.

notes.title: "THE BASKETBALL DIE-ARIES" UPDATE (v1.02)
notes.notes:
NEW FREE CONTENT FOR YOUR EYEBALLS!

 A New Killer Approaches! Save up your SkullCoins and unlock a new psycho killer from the Mystery Box. We're not even going to say who it is... It's THAT SECRET!!!
 Deadly Basketball Bonus Kill: Smash off a victim's head with a horrifyingly deadly pass of an average regulation-sized basketball. 
 Gardening Shears Bonus Kill: Trim those extra leaves and branches off your victims with these freshly sharpened Gardening Shears.


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26314841/1adae0ed4e58ce57f5221808f48bd6f00c57cf56.jpg

SOME BUGS WERE FIXED

 Trap-related Achievements were being sneaky and not unlocking when they should have been. We have since told them off and threatened them with violence. They should now be unlocking correctly.
 Gorepack-related achievements were also being shy and may have not unlocked correctly if you were playing during the Beta test. Well, worry no more... they should now unlock retroactively on game load.
 The gruesomest bootleg VHS tape ever made: Faces of Killed 3 no longer unlocks again after re-entering shelf scene. Yes.
 The zoomed out / overhead view was a little tight on some levels and the buttons on the bottom would overlap the level map a bit. Well... worry no more, because that has been fixed.
 We have made many improvements to the controller support to hopefully allow for wide gamepad support and eliminate bugs and crashing with specific hardware / setups. If you are still having issues, feel free to let us know... also let us know which hardware manufacturer made your gamepad so we can send Skullface to their factory to oversee the quality assurance.
 Rewinding moves that included a trap-cutscene would replay said cutscene until you finally figured out the puzzle surrounding said trap. This has been changed so that trap-related cutscenes will only replay once after restarting a level, not on every rewind.
 A few puzzles had minor bugs fixed throughout them to ensure MAXIMUM KILLFICIENCY. 
 A few minor graphical glitches were resolved for MAXIMUM LOOKFICIENCY
